subject: Error: no method for coercing this S4 class to a vector

messages.author: 1ade312b2b5688ec
messages.subject: Error: no method for coercing this S4 class to a vector
parts:
Hi all,

I'm using the function "usermodel" in your package to run a user-specified model without SNPs. But when I run the "usermodel" step, I got this error message:

[1] "Running primary model"
Error in as.character.default(empty4$value) : 
  no method for coercing this S4 class to a vector
Calls: usermodel -> grepl -> as.character -> as.character.default
Execution halted

Do you have any ideas on what's going on? Thank you so much!

Best,
Stephen
